$janet.$comment: Not JSON Schema. Read by scripts/Test-OutputContracts.ps1, which is the point of the file living here rather than being generated from the return type.
$janet.$comment.contractField: The envelope stamps 'contract' and the gate cross-checks it against the number above, so code and schema cannot drift apart in either direction.
$janet.$comment.diagnosticShared: The diagnostic item is the same shape in azure-whatif and azure-deployment, because one serializer (BicepJson.Diagnostics) writes all three. Changing it here means changing it there.

contract.description: Bumped only by a format change. An engine change that moves this number is a mistake in one direction; a format change that does not is a mistake in the other.

path.description: The full path of the file that was built, after resolving whatever relative path the caller passed.

kind.description: What the file is. 'template' for a .bicep; 'parameters' for a .bicepparam, whose build compiles the template it names as well, so its diagnostics can point into that other file.

succeeded.description: Did the build produce output? Decided by Bicep's exit code, not by counting diagnostics: warnings never fail it, and a SARIF document that failed to parse cannot turn a failed build into a clean one.

errors.description: How many diagnostics have level 'error'. Any at all means succeeded is false.

warnings.description: How many diagnostics have level 'warning' -- linter findings (no-unused-params and the like) and compiler warnings. The build still produced output.

notes.description: How many diagnostics have level 'note': linter rules configured at 'info'.

diagnostics.description: Everything the compiler and its linter said, in the order Bicep reported it, never truncated. Empty means a clean build.

bicepVersion.description: What 'bicep --version' printed, or '(unknown)' when it printed nothing. Linter rules arrive and change between versions, so a finding is only comparable against the version that produced it.

durationSeconds.description: Wall time of the build, rounded to hundredths. Excludes the separate --version call.

level.description: SARIF's level vocabulary, which is what Bicep emits. A result that carries no level is a 'warning' -- SARIF's default, and how Bicep marks linter findings -- so 'warning' here does not mean Bicep said the word. 'none' is in SARIF's vocabulary and is passed through if it ever arrives; it is counted in none of errors, warnings or notes.

code.description: The rule: a BCPnnn compiler code, a linter rule name such as no-unused-params, '(no rule)' when SARIF gave none, or '(bicep)' when Bicep failed and wrote no SARIF at all -- then the message is whatever it printed.

message.description: Bicep's message, verbatim, including the documentation link it appends.

file.description: The file the finding is in, as a local path converted from SARIF's file:/// URI. Can differ from the envelope's path: a .bicepparam reports into its template, and a module into the module. Null when SARIF gave no location.

line.description: 1-based line. Null when SARIF gave no region.

column.description: 1-based column in UTF-16 code units, as Bicep reports it (SARIF's charOffset). Null when SARIF gave no region.
